name: wireguard-nm
title: WireGuard (NetworkManager)
description: Connect and disconnect WireGuard VPN tunnels managed by NetworkManager, from anywhere on Linux.
author: sph33r

commands.name: wireguard
commands.title: WireGuard Connections
commands.subtitle: WireGuard
commands.description: List WireGuard tunnels and connect or disconnect them.

commands.name: toggle-wireguard
commands.title: Toggle WireGuard
commands.subtitle: WireGuard
commands.description: Instantly connect or disconnect a WireGuard tunnel without opening a list.

preferences.name: connectionName
preferences.title: Connection Name
preferences.description: Name of the NetworkManager WireGuard connection to toggle, as shown by `nmcli connection show`. Leave empty to auto-select (the active tunnel, or the only configured one).
